content.value: Modular thinking keeps web applications maintainable. Split features into pages, components, and utility functions. Reuse patterns like header, card, form, and hero sections so your application can scale from a small exercise to a multi-page portfolio without rewriting everything.

concepts.name: Module
concepts.description: A self-contained unit of code or content with a clear responsibility.

concepts.name: Separation of concerns
concepts.description: The practice of keeping different responsibilities in separate files, components, functions, or layers.

concepts.name: File organization
concepts.description: The structure used to group project files so their roles and relationships are understandable.

concepts.name: Component boundary
concepts.description: The line defining what a component owns, exposes, and depends on.

concepts.name: Reusable code
concepts.description: Code written so it can be used in more than one place without duplication.

concepts.name: Project structure
concepts.description: The overall organization of folders, files, modules, assets, and configuration in a project.
